title: Rune publishing configuration
description: Build a player executable and package explicitly included game content. Paths are relative to the game directory; compiler collection paths may refer to sibling dependencies.

id.description: Stable game identity used to name packages. Use the same identity in project save settings.

version.description: Release version used in distribution filenames; independent of save-format versions.

executable.description: Extensionless executable name. Windows adds .exe automatically.

targets.description: Supported native publishing targets. Build each package on its matching operating system.

content.description: Candidate files and complete directories, preserving their paths. All are copied unless prune.enabled selects their reachable subset. A trailing slash is allowed for directories. Include project.json and every possible runtime resource.

licenses.description: Additional game-specific license and credit files or directories. Required Rune dependency notices are added by the publisher.

prune.description: Opt-in reachability pruning of the content inventory. Declare code-loaded resources explicitly; all license entries remain included.

roots.description: Additional reachable files or directory trees within content, beyond project.json and its dependencies.

manifests.description: Project-relative version 1 dependency manifests declaring roots, custom dependency edges, and optional source input hashes. These metadata files need not be included in content.

collections.description: Additional Odin collection names and paths relative to the game root. Parent traversal is allowed for build dependencies. Rune supplies its own rune and r3d collections.

defines.description: Odin compiler defines. The publisher always selects RUNE_PLAYER=true and RAYLIB_SHARED=false.

extra_linker_flags.description: Optional native linker flags passed as one Odin -extra-linker-flags argument.
